_comment: Real agent turns and cron jobs the demo rig starts from. Prompts are self-contained so the agent never needs to read the machine it runs on.
sessions:
Summarise this log excerpt in three bullet points and name the one line that needs attention:
09:00:01 INFO backup started
09:04:12 INFO backup finished, 2.1 GB
09:10:33 WARN disk /var at 86%
09:15:00 INFO cron weekly-digest queued
Answer from the text only; do not run commands.

Draft short release notes (max 5 bullets) for a version that adds line icons to a phone panel, replaces a demo banner with a small pill, and adds a 7-day spend sparkline. Answer from the text only; do not run commands.
A server shows CPU 34%, RAM 71%, disk 86%. Which one would you look at first and why? Two sentences. Do not run commands.
Write a polite two-sentence message telling a team that tonight's deploy moves from 21:00 to 22:00. Do not run commands.
Give me a five-item checklist for rotating an API key safely. Do not run commands.
Explain in three sentences what a cron job with 'repeat: 1' is useful for. Do not run commands.

cron.name: Morning ops brief
cron.prompt: Write a three-line morning checklist for a small ops team. Do not run commands.

cron.name: Friday release notes
cron.prompt: Draft a short weekly release-notes template with three headings. Do not run commands.

cron.name: Weekly digest
cron.prompt: Summarise the week's activity in five bullets.
